SUAS-006 — System Text Segmentation

The sixth SuperUnicode Architecture Standard: a zero-allocation, single-pass state machine for grapheme, word, and sentence boundaries (a UAX #29 analog).

SUAS-006 (STS) is the sixth SuperUnicode Architecture Standard. It defines the grapheme cluster, word, and sentence tiers over the full 64-bit SUCS space (sucs_ex_char_t) via a single single-pass, zero-allocation state machine (a UAX #29 analog). Where UAX #29 relies on multi-scan rulesets with unbounded look-ahead, STS feeds one codepoint at a time and returns the boundary status of the position just resolved in O(1), carrying all necessary context in a bounded register. It powers cursor movement, selection, line wrapping, and paragraph parsing in the kernel compositor and terminal shell.

Three tiers, one engine

Tier Unit Consumers
GRAPHEME User-perceived character Cursor movement, backspace, selection extent
WORD Word / token Double-click selection, spell-check, search
SENTENCE Sentence / paragraph Paragraph parsing, TTS, diff granularity

Boundary status

Status Value Meaning
BOUNDARY_NONE 0 Do not break; the two sides form one unit
BOUNDARY_ALLOW 1 A unit boundary exists here (opportunity)
BOUNDARY_MUST 2 A hard boundary is required

SCP segmentation directives

Explicit in-band control lives in the block 0x00110040–0x0011004F, disjoint from the SBR break block (0x00110020) and the math directives (0x00110030). Directives are transparent: they are never pushed onto the window and never mutate the carried context.

Directive Codepoint Effect
SCP_STS_BREAK_FORCE 0x00110040 Force a boundary (MUST)
SCP_STS_BREAK_BLOCK 0x00110041 Prohibit a boundary (NONE)
SCP_STS_BREAK_ALLOW 0x00110042 Permit a boundary (ALLOW)

Bounded carried context

Every piece of state UAX #29 would recover by rescanning is held in a fixed-size register inside suas_sts_state_t: regional-indicator parity, the emoji ZWJ sequence, the Indic linker run, the effective word class for the WB4 “ignore” rule, and the sentence terminator run. Together with the SUAS_STS_WINDOW_SIZE (4) codepoint ring, the engine is total and allocation-free over arbitrarily long runs.

Feature Status
Single-pass, O(1) per codepoint Yes
Grapheme, word, and sentence tiers Yes
Grapheme rules GB1–GB999 (incl. GB9c, GB11, GB12/13) Yes
Word rules WB1–WB999 (incl. WB4 ignore) Yes
Sentence rules SB1–SB998 (incl. SB5 ignore) Yes
Explicit SCP segmentation directives Yes
Algorithmic Hangul determination Yes
Native / plugin codepoints are opaque (total) Yes
Zero heap allocation, fixed-size state Yes
Freestanding C99 Yes

Reference implementation: include/suas/suas_sts.h + src/suas/suas_sts.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suas_static.

Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-006-sts.md in the repository.
